about_the_game:
"Touhou Unite Arena" is a fan game of the Touhou Project. Players need to choose their own team members and set the captain. In the game, they need to experience various events to strengthen their own [Battle Spell Cards], collect [Spell Cards] or upgrade characters and unlock more powerful character skills.

Illustration: Puzzle of each character's portrait (can be GIF)

Appearing characters and enemies

The game will feature familiar characters from the Touhou Project. Each character has its own special skills, which can help the team win the battle more easily.

Illustration: GIF of the character selection interface

The enemies that the team needs to face are also from the Touhou Project. Each enemy has interesting skill mechanisms according to its own characteristics - choose the right time to play Break, or go all in to kill at all costs, it all depends on your choice.

Illustration: GIF of the enemy's appearance

Battle Spell Cards and Combinations

In battle, use the skills of the [Battle Spell Cards] with the correct combination to cause damage to the enemy and eventually defeat the enemy. You can choose to continuously hit the enemy's weaknesses, or you can choose a higher-level skill combination. The enemy's health is ultimately limited, but the combination of [Battle Spell Cards] in your hand may be "infinite"

Image: GIF of the character using skills

The magical charm of the wonderful spell card

After winning a battle or other event nodes, you can randomly obtain various [Spell Cards]. Some of them can directly strengthen the captain, or strengthen [Skills], or strengthen [Battle Spell Cards]. Some can even be used directly to reverse the final battle situation.

Image: GIF of the character using skills

Main features

●Character team: Using different character skills can also form a powerful build

●Hand card enhancement: Upgrading hand cards in battle may also be a means of resurrection!

●Random construction: Character skills, spell cards, enhanced buffs, etc. make the direction of the battle full of possibilities

●Strategic depth: Enemy mechanisms are different, and flexible targeting of weaknesses is the top priority

In short, "Eastern Alliance" has begun, and you can lead your team to fight for the final victory!

short_description: "Touhou Unite Arena" is a card Roguelike game based on the theme of the Touhou Project. Build your own team, combine the spell cards in your hand, play explosive attack values, defeat the target enemy step by step, and challenge the final champion!
